prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1065; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed correspondence. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all future communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person.

Within fourteen days of receipt of this letter, please provide written confirmation of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page. We also request disclosure of any other coverage that may apply to this loss, including excess or umbrella policies.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle inspection reports, telematics or event data, repair estimates, and all communications with your insured or any third party. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions and adverse inferences in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt response.
